scope: Independent evidence-derived v3 indicator evidence and final hard-gate evaluation only.
does_not_change: The frozen K/Q/P search frame or its hashes.
The round-12 terminal stopping decision or its actual nonzero novelty endpoints.
Any H1 or H2 source quotation, source-reported formula field, or source disposition.
The requirement for lawful hashed English primary or foundational full text.
The requirement for article-level T0 computability, no future information, audited local data, nonconstancy, bias safeguards, and outcome-blind selection.
The prohibition on a review article authorizing a final formula.
The absence of a target indicator or dimension count.

trigger.observation: Before H2 adjudication, the blind H1 census contained 27 mentions with a non-placeholder formula or algorithm description. All 27 explicitly recorded that the source did not report a missing-data rule; seven were provisionally T0-computable. Treating a literal 'Not reported' placeholder as a complete formula would be false provenance, while treating source non-reporting alone as a fatal mathematical defect would confound reporting completeness with reproducible project operationalization.
trigger.decision_timing: This amendment was frozen before H2 produced any final indicator decisions, before candidate dimensions were derived, before local feature audits were imported, and before model outcomes or performance were inspected.

layer_1_literature_formula_evidence.purpose: Establish what the indicator is and what the English source actually reports.
requirements: An H2-approved original definition, original application, or mathematical-foundation mention.
A lawful frozen English full-text file with a verified SHA-256.
An exact auditable page, table, equation, appendix, or section location and English evidence span.
A source-supported formula or deterministic algorithm, units or scale, parameters, direction, required inputs, and maximum information time.
No review-discovery mention may authorize this layer.
Any source-reported missing-data rule is retained verbatim; an absent rule remains explicitly 'not reported' and is never inferred as a source claim.

layer_2_project_operationalization.purpose: Specify how the verified literature definition is computed reproducibly on the frozen local data without pretending that project choices were reported by the source.
requirements: A deterministic derivation specification linked to one eligible layer-1 mention.
A project missing-data rule that distinguishes absent input, mathematically undefined values, observed empty sets, structural non-applicability, and valid zero values.
Explicit denominator-zero, empty-set, incomplete-coverage, parameter, transform, unit, direction, and data-type behavior where applicable.
Exact frozen input columns and snapshot hashes, implementation path and hash, and deterministic tests for edge cases.
No imputation from outcomes, no use of model performance, and no feature- or dimension-count target.
Independent H1 review followed by independent H2 adjudication of every retained operationalization.

hard_gate_interpretation.G04_REPRODUCIBLE_DEFINITION: Passes only when both layers are complete and H2 approved. An incomplete source formula cannot be rescued by a project operationalization. A source-complete formula with an unreviewed project missing rule also fails.
hard_gate_interpretation.G13_ENGLISH_FULLTEXT_FORMULA_EVIDENCE: Still requires the eligible layer-1 English full-text evidence and cannot be satisfied by local code, a review, metadata, an abstract, or the operationalization layer.
hard_gate_interpretation.source_reported_missing_rule: Stored separately from the project operationalization and may remain 'not reported'.
hard_gate_interpretation.protocol_missing_rule: Stored only in the operationalization record with its rationale, implementation, tests, reviewers, and hashes.
hard_gate_interpretation.selection_rule: The composed gate is applied uniformly to every canonical indicator family before redundancy resolution and without consulting prediction outcomes.

review_roles.primary_ai: May prepare a source-linked operationalization draft but cannot approve it.
review_roles.H1: Independently reviews the literature-to-implementation correspondence, missing and boundary behavior, frozen inputs, and tests without seeing H2 decisions or model outcomes.
review_roles.H2: Adjudicates every H1 operationalization and may approve, revise, or reject it; approval cannot create missing layer-1 formula evidence.

audit_outputs: A field-level provenance table separating source-reported and project-specified values.
The H1 and H2 operationalization worksheets and immutable manifests.
The exact derivation/input/test hashes used by each passing feature.
A hard-gate report showing the literature layer and operationalization layer separately.
A protocol-deviation disclosure explaining why this separation was introduced.
